TOOLKIT

A complete presentation toolkit

Years of development mean Pitch has everything fast-moving teams need to create and deliver consistently beautiful slides together, from design fundamentals to the latest in AI-powered workflows.

AI Agent

Use Pitch Agent to generate on-brand slides, personalize messaging, enhance visuals, and more.

Slide editor

Unlock a powerful yet intuitive slide editor, where you have complete control over design and placement.

Viewer analytics

Know when to follow up, with visitor data on everyone who opens and interacts with your decks and pitch rooms.

Pitch rooms

Share presentations and resources in custom deal rooms to deliver a truly personalized client experience.

Brand library

Keep everything consistent with custom fonts, templates, and your approved brand media in a shared team library.

Team organization

Collaborate in the cloud. Organize your work and stay on top of everything you’ve created or shared.

Unrivaled visuals

Showcase your high-res brand media, create eye-catching animations, embed interactive content or generate with AI.

FAQS

Not just another slide tool

  • Is Pitch free to use?

    Yes, Pitch’s Free plan lets you create unlimited presentations forever.

    You can learn more about our Plus, Team, and Business plans on our pricing page. Each plan’s price depends on the amount of seats you need and is billed on a monthly or annual subscription.

  • Can I hire Pitch to build my presentation for me?

    We don’t offer custom design services, but you’re in good hands. Use Pitch Agent to generate a presentation in seconds, or choose from over 150 templates in our gallery for a head start. We can also recommend great creative agencies familiar with Pitch if you’d like further help.

  • Does Pitch offer a free trial?

    Free trials are available to some customers depending on their needs. Please contact support if you would like more information about this option.

  • Can I import my existing deck, and if so, in what format?

    Yes! You can upload a PPTX file. If you’re coming from Google Slides, Keynote, or another tool, export to PPTX so you can use our importer.
